entities.name: Manatarqua
entities.description: Young, inexperienced planeswalker who hid in an illusory pavilion and died in a fireball.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who encountered Manatarqua and left the congregation.

events.summary: Manatarqua hid in the form of a small illusory pavilion, fearing predatory planeswalkers.
events.quote: Manatarqua hid herself in the form of a small, fanciful, and entirely illusory pavilion

events.summary: When Urza decided to leave, some force attacked the group with a fireball onto the pavilion.
events.quote: some force (probably another planeswalker) attacked the group, sending a sun-hot fireball onto the pavilion

events.summary: Manatarqua died consumed by the blast.
events.quote: Manatarqua died consumed by the blast

relations.quote: a blind dwarf and Manatarqua's spellsquire
